item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00491","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C25","C04","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C25","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C25 supplies a close and material one-sentence administrative template: an identified federal entity or its functions are placed \"under the direction and supervision\" of a named department head. The child compresses the same distinctive language and supervisory machinery into a direction that the Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation \"shall be subject to the direction and supervision of the Secretary of Defense.\" C04 is also a strong parallel because it transfers an entity to an official's jurisdiction and requires administration under his \"direction and supervision,\" while C06 uses the related but less exact formulation \"subject to the direction and control.\"","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation shall be subject to the direction and supervision of the Secretary of Defense","parent_excerpt":"The functions of the Council shall be performed under the direction and supervision of the Administrator of General Services.","explanation":"Both provisions place a specified federal entity or its functions under the direction and supervision of a named senior official, using nearly identical operative language and the same administrative mechanism."}]}
